question: The writer is considering adding the following sentence to the end of paragraph 3: "Breweries at the time were among the fastest-growing businesses in the city." Should the writer make this addition?

options.A: Yes, because paragraph 3 names hotels and fish dealers as buyers but never says who took the cheaper grade of ice.
options.B: No, because paragraph 3 sorts the ice by clarity and price, and the growth of the breweries has no bearing on that sorting.
options.C: No, because paragraph 5 attributes the end of the trade to breweries installing their own refrigeration, and praising their growth here would confuse that account.
options.D: Yes, because it explains why the breweries could afford to buy the cloudy ice even at half the usual price.
